mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_daily_stats(user_id, quiz_date, total_questions, correct_answers, last_quiz_at) VALUES(#{userId}, CURDATE(), 1, #{correct} = true, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_questions = total_questions + 1, correct_answers = correct_answers + (#{correct} = true), last_quiz_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quiz_daily_stats WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND quiz_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) ORDER BY quiz_date ASC

choose.when: SELECT agg.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, agg.correct, agg.total, CASE WHEN agg.total > 0 THEN ROUND(agg.correct * 100.0 / agg.total, 1) ELSE 0 END AS accuracy, agg.last_quiz_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_leaderboard_like l WHERE l.to_user_id = agg.user_id AND l.like_date = CURDATE()) AS likes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_leaderboard_like l2 WHERE l2.to_user_id = agg.user_id AND l2.from_user_id = #{viewerId} AND l2.like_date = CURDATE()) AS liked_by_me FROM ( SELECT user_id, SUM(correct_answers) AS correct, SUM(total_questions) AS total, MAX(COALESCE(last_quiz_at, TIMESTAMP(quiz_date))) AS last_quiz_at FROM quiz_daily_stats WHERE quiz_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) DAY) AND quiz_date <= CURDATE() GROUP BY user_id ) agg JOIN user u ON u.id = agg.user_id ORDER BY agg.correct DESC, accuracy DESC, agg.last_quiz_at ASC, agg.user_id ASC
choose.otherwise: SELECT s.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, s.correct_answers AS correct, s.total_questions AS total, CASE WHEN s.total_questions > 0 THEN ROUND(s.correct_answers * 100.0 / s.total_questions, 1) ELSE 0 END AS accuracy, COALESCE(s.last_quiz_at, TIMESTAMP(s.quiz_date)) AS last_quiz_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_leaderboard_like l WHERE l.to_user_id = s.user_id AND l.like_date = CURDATE()) AS likes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quiz_leaderboard_like l2 WHERE l2.to_user_id = s.user_id AND l2.from_user_id = #{viewerId} AND l2.like_date = CURDATE()) AS liked_by_me FROM quiz_daily_stats s JOIN user u ON u.id = s.user_id WHERE s.quiz_date = CURDATE() ORDER BY s.correct_answers DESC, accuracy DESC, last_quiz_at ASC, s.user_id ASC
